values: Fill Members and Plans. Examples below are fictional; do not copy them as real members.
Enter the latest membership only. Use one workbook per gym organization; identify its branch on every row.
Do not rename sheets or headings, merge cells, or enter totals. Start at row 2. Save as .xlsx.
Leave optional unknown details blank. Enter 0 only when the value is genuinely zero.
Use digits only, no spaces or +91 in Mobile Number. Put +91 separately in Country Code.
One mobile number per gym organization, even across branches. Existing members must be matched before any insert.
List each distinct plan in Plans. Repeat its exact Plan Name in Members; prices are rupees, not paise.
Enter real Excel dates displayed as yyyy-mm-dd. End Date means the last valid day, inclusive.
Leave training fields blank if none. Training must fit entirely within the membership dates.
RECEIVED = fully paid; PENDING = unpaid/part-paid; ENQUIRED = enquiry only, not an active membership.
Enter the proposed membership plan, but leave membership/training dates blank until confirmed.
For RECEIVED, supply amount and payment date. Add UPI/card reference when available; never invent a reference.
Do not include passwords, UPI PINs, Aadhaar, card numbers or bank login details.
Prepared for 200 members and 50 plans. Request an expanded file if more rows are needed.
Return the filled workbook for validation and a preview. No database records are changed by this file.
Historical dates, paid amounts, references and branch mapping need migration handling; the current registration API does not accept all of them.
Exact organization name, identical on every row.
Exact branch name; use Main only if that is the actual branch name.
Text; API allows 6–15 digits. Indian mobile numbers should have 10 digits.
Exact MEMBERSHIP Plan Name from Plans, including for an enquiry.
Exact PERSONAL_TRAINING Plan Name from Plans; blank if none.
Actual start of the latest membership; do not substitute today.
Last valid day, inclusive. Must agree with the plan and any approved extensions.
First day of training, no earlier than membership start.
Last valid training day, no later than membership end.
Select PERCENTAGE or FIXED_AMOUNT. For no discount, use FIXED_AMOUNT and 0.
Percentage 0–100 or rupee amount; up to 2 decimals. Cannot exceed combined plan cost.
Select UPI, CASH or CARD; for unpaid customers use intended mode.
Select RECEIVED, PENDING or ENQUIRED. Do not use Not Onboarded.
Actual amount already received for this membership, after discount. Enter 0 if unpaid.
Actual date of payment; do not use the import date.
Exact UPI/card reference as text; leave blank for cash or if unknown.
Explain extensions, partial payments or missing historical details.
Branch where this plan applies; mapping will be reviewed before import.
Unique descriptive name within gym and plan type, maximum 150 characters.
Positive whole number. Quarterly = 3 MONTH; half-yearly = 6 MONTH.
Select DAY, WEEK, MONTH or YEAR. No free-text variants.
Whole rupees before discount, matching current plan API. Flag fractional legacy prices in member Notes.
